statement.domain: P-operators A:L^infinity(Omega)->L^1(Omega) on a Borel probability space
statement.self_adjoint: for all bounded measurable u,v, integral (Av)u dmu = integral (Au)v dmu
statement.positivity_preserving: for all v>=0 almost everywhere, Av>=0 almost everywhere

tested_instances: a nonnegative symmetric 3-cell step graphon integral operator
the sum-aggregation adjacency operator of the sparse path P4

proof_scope.finite_atomic_certificate: Exhaustive over {-1,0,1}^n signal pairs for self-adjointness and {0,1}^n nonnegative signals for positivity.
proof_scope.general_structural_argument: For a symmetric nonnegative kernel, exchanging the two finite sums proves adjointness and entrywise nonnegativity proves positivity. The canonical finite-graph construction is the same argument with adjacency entries.

acceptance: all exact adjoint residuals are zero
all outputs on the complete nonnegative Boolean signal domain are nonnegative
the exact L-infinity to L1 norm is finite
an independent checker reaches the same verdict without importing the primary verifier
asymmetric and negative-entry controls are rejected for their intended reasons
